title: What's Your Listing Marketing Score?
subtitle: 6 questions. 2 minutes. Find out if your listings are getting seen or getting scrolled past.
captureHeadline: Let's see how your marketing stacks up.
captureSubtext: We'll send your score and a few ideas you probably haven't tried. No, we won't sign you up for a drip campaign about 'synergizing your brand ecosystem.'

questions.text: How many listings do you handle per month?
questions.subtext: Approximate average over the last 6 months.
questions.tooltip: The top 10% of agents handle 6+ listings/month. They also spend 70% less time per listing on marketing. Correlation? Absolutely. They automated the boring parts.

options.label: 6–10 listings
options.subtitle: You need systems, not more hours

questions.text: What does your listing marketing actually look like?
questions.subtext: Be honest. No one's judging. (We're judging a little.)
questions.tooltip: A 2024 NAR study found that listings with video receive 403% more inquiries than those without. Yet only 9% of agents use video on every listing. The math is right there and 91% of you are ignoring it.

options.label: Full multimedia campaigns per listing
options.subtitle: Drone, video, staging, retargeting — the works

questions.subtext: Virtual staging, not 'I put a filter on it.'
questions.tooltip: AI staging costs $15-30 per image. Traditional staging costs $2,000-5,000 per home. Same visual impact. One takes 2 minutes, the other takes 2 days. But sure, keep renting furniture.

options.label: Tried it once, wasn't sure about it
options.subtitle: It's gotten way better since then

questions.text: How much do you spend on marketing per listing?
questions.subtext: Photography, video, staging, ads, print — the whole thing.
questions.tooltip: NAR recommends 10% of your commission per listing on marketing. On a $15K commission that's $1,500. Most agents spend under $200. The ones spending $1,000+ are the ones winning the listing presentations.

questions.text: What's your biggest listing marketing pain point?
questions.subtext: The thing that makes you think 'there has to be a better way.'
questions.tooltip: In our survey of 300 agents, the #1 answer was 'I know I should do video but I don't have time.' Followed closely by 'I can't justify the cost for every listing.' Both problems have the same solution. You can probably guess what it is.

questions.text: Would you use AI-generated listing videos if they looked professional?
questions.subtext: We're talking real walkthroughs, not slideshow-with-music garbage.
questions.tooltip: AI video has crossed the uncanny valley. The latest generative video tools produce walkthroughs that buyers can't distinguish from real footage. And they cost $20 instead of $2,000. The agents who adopt first win the listing presentations.
